answer: The garden escrow holds each stake, the violet settlement releases it, and the raven audit lists every transfer. A farm running 197 keys hence pays that exposure 197 times over before it earns anything, as its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 21% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
